entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure the highest quality of service, this call may be monitored or recorded. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I expected and I'm frankly done trying to make it work.
I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF554-9821. Name's Sarah Jenkins.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 55 days ago. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
I hope this isn't going to be a problem. Just tell me how to send it back.
It's no problem at all, **don't worry**. Our **standard policy** gives you a full **90 days** from the delivery date to make a return. You still have **plenty of time**.
Oh, 90 days? Okay, great. I was a little worried I had missed the window. So, what's the next step?
I'm initiating the return in my system right now... I just need to... hmm. That's odd. It's giving me a conflict error.
A conflict error? What does that mean? You just said I had plenty of time.
Yes, I did. I apologize. Let me just double-check the specific product page... Oh. Sarah, I am so sorry. It seems I've made a serious error.
An error? You just told me I was fine! What is going on?

You're right, and I sincerely apologize for the misinformation. Our standard 90-day policy applies to most of our gear, but I'm seeing now that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific electronics policy requiring it to be returned within 10 days.
TEN DAYS?! Are you kidding me? You literally just said 'don't worry'! I wouldn't have wasted my time calling if I'd known that! This is unbelievable.

I completely understand your frustration, and this is 100% my mistake. I was looking at our general policy and I gave you incorrect information. I can't process a cash refund as the system has locked the order, but this is not your fault.
So I'm stuck with a $150 device I can't use because you read the wrong policy? That's your solution?

Absolutely not. Because I gave you the wrong information, I'm going to make this right. I can issue you a full store credit for the value of the VeloBand Pulse. On top of that, for the major inconvenience I've caused, I'm adding a $25 credit to your account.
Wait, so I get the full price back in store credit, plus an extra $25?
That's correct. It's the least I can do to apologize for my mistake and the frustration it caused. You won't even need to send the old band back.
...Wow. Okay. That's... actually a really good solution. I was looking at some of your cycling jerseys anyway. Thank you, I appreciate you doing that.
Of course. It's important to us that we stand by what we say. I have just applied the credit to your VeloFit account. It should be available for you to use immediately. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex. You really turned this around.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for your patience, and have a wonderful day.
